message.content: In the discussions provided, there is a mention of a new software project where WolfgangSchulz feels pressured and needs support. One of the key features they are hoping for in this new software project involves the resource system. Specifically, the team hopes for a mix of resources including materials for crafting weapons and armor, rare items for upgrades, and even in-game currency for trading. Additionally, they desire the inclusion of consumables such as health potions and buffs to enhance gameplay. This indicates that the new game aims to provide a robust and engaging resource management system, which will involve strategic gameplay and decision-making related to gathering and utilizing these resources.
